title: FCA to explore quantum computing to tackle financial crime
summary: A new initiative will bring together firms, quantum technology providers, and national research labs to explore practical applications of quantum computing. title: 2026-11-05 - Martin Schlegel: Transmission and conduct of monetary policy in Switzerland
summary: To achieve its mandate, a central bank needs to understand how its actions affect the financial system and the economy. Switzerland is a small open economy with a stable political and institutional environment. This creates a special setting for monetary policy. Our main tool is the SNB policy rate. If necessary, the SNB also uses other measures. Understanding the transmission of our monetary policy to the Swiss economy is important for the SNB in achieving its mandate. Changes in the policy rate affect monetary and financial conditions. Short- and long-term rates change, and asset prices and the exchange rate move. This affects consumption and investment, as well as imports and exports. According to our estimates for Switzerland, both the 10-year interest rate and the exchange rate go up after a policy rate increase. One year after the increase, both inflation and output are lower. title: Director-General: Leverage trade and partnerships to build a resilient ocean economy
summary: The multilateral trading system provides important tools for the development of a healthy and prosperous ocean economy, Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her keynote speech at an event on "Trade, Biodiversity and the Ocean Economy: Pathways to Resilience" at the WTO on 5 November. Highlighting the importance of strengthening support for coastal and island economies, she said: "Trade is part of the answer. The oceans are an asset of the global commons that can best be managed through multilateral approaches." The event was co-organized by Belgium, Fiji and Portugal.
